Original preserves three attacking-end-zone receiving zones, eight main-field throwing zones, and a Callahan bottom panel. metricDefinitions.label: Thrower aEC
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum the supplied aEC for completions and non-drop turnovers. A dropped throw contributes zero to the thrower.

metricDefinitions.label: Receiver aEC
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum supplied aEC for completions and drops credited to the named receiver. Untargeted throwaways have no receiver credit.

metricDefinitions.label: Overall aEC
metricDefinitions.definition: Overall aEC is each player’s thrower aEC plus receiver aEC within the same box. Thrower credit uses the release location; receiver credit uses the catch/drop location. Both roles are ranked together per player, including in the own end zone. This adds player-role credits, not unique possession value.

metricDefinitions.label: Callahan aEC
metricDefinitions.definition: Reconstruction of the reference panel: negate the opposing Callahan throw aEC and assign it to the uniquely matched defender. This is separate from offensive player totals.

metricDefinitions.label: Completion rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed throws divided by all throws in the selected player and zone. For receiving: catches divided by catches plus recorded drops.

metricDefinitions.label: Passing connections
metricDefinitions.definition: For the selected player, count each eligible pass from a teammate on the incoming side and to a teammate on the outgoing side. The sides are separate event totals across the selected games, not a sequence within one possession. Stalls are excluded.

metricDefinitions.label: Huck passes
metricDefinitions.definition: A huck has recorded flight distance sqrt((rx-tx)^2 + (ry-ty)^2) > 40 yards and forward gain ry-ty > 30 yards. The source normalizes every offense toward y=120. Missing coordinates cannot qualify. Hucks only filters incoming and outgoing passes.

metricDefinitions.label: Connection outcomes
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed passes is the default. All pass attempts additionally includes drops and other incompletions, without discarding unnamed targets. Unrecorded player means the source did not name that endpoint; an intended receiver is never inferred.

metricDefinitions.label: Displayed partners
metricDefinitions.definition: Rank each side independently by eligible pass count. Top 5 and Top 10 retain remaining partners in an additive Other players group. All partners shows every recorded partner. Source rows retain every original pass once, and a selected link retrieves only its corresponding passes.

metricDefinitions.label: Radial direction buckets
metricDefinitions.definition: Reproduce prod.get_player_throw_directions from its read-only October 12, 2026 definition: normalize supplied throwAngle modulo 360 and group by floor(angle / 30). Twelve buckets include their lower edge and exclude their upper edge. Missing angles are excluded, not reconstructed.

metricDefinitions.label: Radial counts and shares
metricDefinitions.definition: Count thrower and receiver involvement separately. Each bucket share divides its count by the selected role’s total events with recorded angles, after the team, season phase, line, player, outcome and huck filters. The pass list deduplicates shared source events; role totals are not a possession total. An empty role has no percentage denominator.

metricDefinitions.label: Radial outcomes
metricDefinitions.definition: All recorded (original) matches the function’s inclusion of incompletions, named targets and stalls. Completed passes keeps complete=true only. Receiving is the named Receiver endpoint, including unsuccessful targets when All recorded is selected. Unnamed targets are never inferred. The huck filter excludes stalls, as in Connections.

metricDefinitions.label: Radial display
metricDefinitions.definition: Rendered Shown Space profile inspected October 14, 2026: 0 degrees at the top, clockwise; wedges centered on each bucket’s lower-edge angle; receiving angles are not rotated. Radius is innerRadius + (outerRadius-innerRadius) * bucketShare / scaleMaximum. Original scale uses each role’s maximum share; Shared percentage uses the maximum across both roles. Length, not wedge area, encodes frequency; outer-ring percentages disclose the scale.

metricDefinitions.label: Deep thrower performance
metricDefinitions.definition: Hucks use the Connections definition: non-stall throws with endpoint flight >40 yards and forward gain >30 yards. Completion is completed hucks / all huck attempts, retaining drops and unnamed targets. Huck share is hucks / non-stall throws with all four finite endpoint coordinates; missing geometry is excluded from this denominator. Individual huck records and CSV exports retain the supplied thrower aEC.

metricDefinitions.label: Deep thrower field zones
metricDefinitions.definition: Use the same twelve exhaustive field zones as the full-field views, normalized toward y=120. Receiving counts completed catches at rx/ry; release performance uses hucks at tx/ty. Catch shares divide by all catches in the selected receiving view, including any unmapped catches. Out-of-field endpoints are excluded only from spatial cells, with counts disclosed. The zone minimum applies to performance shading, the highest-observed-zone summary and eligibility when ranking a particular release zone. Low-sample cells in otherwise eligible rows retain their counts. Profile source rows and exports retain every selected huck. Counts are never converted into area-normalized densities; zone sizes differ.

metricDefinitions.label: Verified pass before a huck
metricDefinitions.definition: Within the page-scoped events, match by game, team, quarter, point and possession. The prior pass has possessionThrow exactly one less than the huck; both order keys and event sequence keys must be unique within that context, and the prior eventSequence must be smaller. Require a completed, non-stall prior pass whose receiver is the huck thrower. Missing, first-throw and ambiguous cases remain unmatched, not inferred as dead-disc starts. The preceding catch is the prior pass destination, which may differ from the next recorded release. No receiver movement, upline, swing, defensive position or dead-disc label is inferred.

metricDefinitions.label: Deep thrower leaderboard
metricDefinitions.definition: One matrix row per named thrower, with completion rates and completed/attempted hucks by release zone. The player minimum uses all hucks in the team, phase and line scope. Ranking one zone additionally requires the zone minimum there. The completion filter applies to the ranked location: at least the scope baseline by default, or at least 70%, at least 80%, or any rate. All eligibility filters precede name/team search. Sort uses the chosen location and selected measure descending, then attempts, then completion rate, then player ID. Attempt sorting measures volume, not quality. The scope baseline pools all named throwers before sample minimums, completion filtering and search, summing numerators and denominators rather than averaging rates. Source rows include their non-stall throws to preserve huck-share denominators. Display rows contain the complete matching leaderboard plus scope baseline in player/zone long form; pagination shows fifteen players. Nine non-attacking-end-zone columns remain visible; attacking-end-zone columns are added if they have attempts or are the selected ranking zone. Unmapped releases remain in all-location totals. The fixed 0–100% color scale is identical across columns; below-minimum cells are hatched. These are observed outcomes, not difficulty-adjusted ratings or learned archetypes.

metricDefinitions.label: Release location comparisons
metricDefinitions.definition: Compare a player’s completion rate in a release zone with their overall huck completion rate under the same team, phase and line scope. The overall rate includes the selected zone and any unmapped releases. Difference is zone rate minus overall rate, displayed in percentage points; no-attempt differences remain undefined. Leaderboard tooltips also show the pooled all-thrower completion rate for that location. These are descriptive comparisons, not disjoint cohorts, causal effects, receiver-adjusted or difficulty-adjusted ratings. Location findings require the selected zone attempt minimum and retain completed/attempted counts.

metricDefinitions.label: Incoming pass tendencies
metricDefinitions.definition: Classify the verified prior disc-flight vector as forward when dy > abs(dx), backward when -dy > abs(dx), otherwise lateral when distance is nonzero. Thus exact 45-degree boundaries belong to lateral. Missing or ambiguous links, missing prior coordinates and zero-distance passes are unclassified; no dead-disc or cutting-route label is inferred. Within each group, huck choice is huck attempts / non-stall next throws with finite current endpoints, while huck completion is completed hucks / huck attempts. Catches with no recorded next throw are not opportunities in this denominator. All setups pools the same groups, including unclassified. Release-location filtering uses current tx/ty; page team/phase/line filters apply first. Missing current geometry is disclosed and excluded from both rates. Source rows include every scoped next throw and its verified prior pass, deduplicated by event ID. Inspect actions select the exact group and release zone; CSV exports preserve the prior-pass category and original IDs. These are descriptive tendencies, not causal effects or comparisons adjusted for receivers, opponents, pressure or throw distance.

metricDefinitions.label: Deep thrower sampling uncertainty
metricDefinitions.definition: Release-zone tooltips report a two-sided 95% Wilson interval for completed / attempted hucks, with z=1.959963984540054. Empty rates are undefined. These binomial intervals do not adjust for dependence between throws, opponents or games and do not establish a causal location effect or statistically significant pairwise differences. Highest-observed-zone summaries rank completion rates and require the selected attempt minimum; ties break by attempts then zone ID. The player minimum affects only the leaderboard; the zone minimum also controls the player profile shading and highest-observed-zone summary.

metricDefinitions.label: Distance and angle population
metricDefinitions.definition: The independently selected players and player finder use all available 2026 non-stall attempts, including playoffs, incompletions, drops and unrecorded targets. The selected distance range applies to both sections. Source rows retain all non-stall player attempts for the frequency denominator; displayed rows hold the derived distributions or matching player summaries.

metricDefinitions.label: Similar arrows
metricDefinitions.definition: For each named player, calculate the circular mean angle from positive-distance attempts with recorded angles in the shared distance range. Match Player 1 using the shortest angular separation abs(((angle-reference+180) mod 360)-180), at or below the selected tolerance. Exclude Player 1 and undefined mean directions. Default tolerance is 15 degrees; default minimum is 20 throws in the distance range. Both are visible, adjustable browsing filters, not fitted archetypes or reliability thresholds. Team filtering restricts candidates, not the reference. Sort by angular separation, then count descending, then name and ID. Similar mean angles do not establish similar full distributions, playing ability, or repeatability.

metricDefinitions.label: Throws by direction finder
metricDefinitions.definition: Intersect the shared distance range with one source 30-degree angle bin and the candidate team filter. Distance lower edge is included and upper excluded; angle bins normalize source throwAngle into [0,360) and include lower edges. Any direction keeps all located attempts, including zero-distance or missing-angle throws. A selected angle bin requires positive distance and a recorded angle. Minimum matching throws applies after both filters. Matching throws counts all attempts, including incomplete throws and drops. % of all throws = matching attempts / every non-stall attempt by that player, including missing coordinates in the denominator. Completion % = matching completions / matching attempts. Highest-frequency ordering uses this share; highest-completion ordering uses this rate, without difficulty adjustment.

metricDefinitions.label: Finder evidence and comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: Primary events evidence includes all non-stall attempts for the candidate rows, preserving their denominators, plus Player 1 when its mean defines the search. shownSpaceThrowers evidence supplies the unchanged player directory and team identity. Display rows contain the sorted eligible players before the table text search and pagination. Arrow and distance averages describe the shared distance range; they are shown only in Similar arrows mode. The direction-search table shows matching counts, frequency and completion instead. Compare loads a candidate into Player 2 while retaining Player 1 and the shared distance range. The comparison diagrams retain all directions; the finder direction is outlined without changing the diagrams’ counts or averages. Filters and selections are local to this view and reset on reload.

metricDefinitions.label: Distance range
metricDefinitions.definition: Straight-line Euclidean endpoint distance sqrt((rx-tx)^2+(ry-ty)^2), not forward gain. Include distances at or above the lower input and strictly below the upper input. Default 15–20 means 15 <= distance <20. Use 15–16 for a one-yard band, or 14.5–15.5 for throws rounding to 15 yards. All distances sets a range that includes the largest recorded distance. Invalid inputs show an error, not stale results. Missing coordinates cannot be assigned to a range and are disclosed.

metricDefinitions.label: Distance range frequency
metricDefinitions.definition: Number of matching attempts divided by every non-stall attempt by the same player, in the same season scope. Missing-location attempts stay in the denominator. This is different from a direction slice’s share, which uses only the selected-range throws with a usable direction.

metricDefinitions.label: Average throw distance
metricDefinitions.definition: Arithmetic mean of the unrounded Euclidean distances of the selected throws. Zero-distance throws are included. Empty selection is unavailable, not zero. This is the mean attempted distance, including incomplete throws, rather than yards gained or distance on completions only.

metricDefinitions.label: Average throw angle
metricDefinitions.definition: Circular mean atan2(mean(sin(theta)), mean(cos(theta))) in degrees using source throwAngle, with equal weight per positive-distance throw. 0 degrees is forward, positive angles rotate left, negative right, and 180 is backward. Source angles agree with atan2(tx-rx, ry-ty) for all 77,822 positive-distance non-stall throws in the snapshot. Zero distance and missing angles are excluded from this mean and the direction distribution, while remaining in the distance summary when coordinates exist. An empty angle sample or mean-resultant magnitude below 1e-12 is unavailable; this threshold only handles numerical cancellation. The mean is not the most frequent angle and can hide opposing directions. Method reference: https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.circmean.html .

metricDefinitions.label: Most common direction
metricDefinitions.definition: Use the source’s twelve 30-degree direction bins: normalize throwAngle into [0,360), then floor(angle/30). Lower edge included, upper excluded. 0–180 is shown on the left of forward, 180–360 on the right, with explicit left/right labels. Show every bin tied for the maximum positive count. No observations means no leading direction. These are display bins, not learned archetypes or an exact most frequent continuous angle.

metricDefinitions.label: Direction comparison diagram
metricDefinitions.definition: All positive-distance throws with a recorded angle in the selected range are counted once. Each wedge’s radial bar length is proportional to its share of those throws. Both players share the same outer-ring scale, rounded up to the next five percentage points; the outer-ring value is printed below. Purple arrows use a fixed length to indicate the circular mean direction, not mean distance. Each mean and mode remains based on the entire selected range when drilling into a direction’s records.

metricDefinitions.label: Throwing comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: Two independently selected players, full available 2026 season including playoffs and all lines. Each field shows every matching non-stall attempt, including drops, incompletions and unnamed targets. Source rows preserve all non-stall attempts for the selected players; displayed rows are the matching throws in the selected distance band or huck filter. Shared source rows are deduplicated when the same player is selected twice. No sample-size threshold or custom quality score.

metricDefinitions.label: Distance bands
metricDefinitions.definition: Straight-line Euclidean endpoint distance, in any direction. The 0–10, 10–20, 20–30 and 30–40 yard bands include the lower edge and exclude the upper edge. Exactly 10 yards belongs to 10–20; exactly 20 to 20–30; exactly 30 to 30–40; exactly 40 to 40+. Zero-distance records appear as dots in 0–10. These five distance bands partition every non-stall attempt with complete endpoint coordinates. Hucks are a separate overlapping filter, not an extra distance band.

metricDefinitions.label: 40+ yard throws
metricDefinitions.definition: Euclidean endpoint distance sqrt((rx-tx)^2+(ry-ty)^2) >=40 yards, in any direction. Do not substitute the rounded source throwDistance field. Hucks use the separate strict rule: distance >40 AND ry-ty >30. Stalls are excluded from every distance band and the huck filter.

metricDefinitions.label: Filtered CPOE
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × ((completed or recorded-dropped attempts)/all selected non-stall attempts − mean available source cp). Values are percentage points (pp), not percent change. Positive means more credited completions than expected. Drops receive thrower completion credit, unlike actual completion %. The summary follows the selected distance band or huck filter. The same calculation reproduces CPOE and xCP for all 5,383 nonempty player-game groups comparable to prod.player_stats_game, queried read-only November 4, 2026. Expected completion excludes missing cp; all selected outcomes stay in the first term, matching the source aggregate convention. Coverage is disclosed. No attempts or no available cp means unavailable.

metricDefinitions.label: Individual throw CPOE
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × (credited outcome − cp), where credited outcome is 1 for a completed pass or recorded drop, otherwise 0. Missing cp stays unavailable. This derived residual uses the supplied completion model and verified aggregate drop convention. Do not copy or average the stored per-throw cpoe field: it is 1.0 on drops. A single completed pass therefore has positive CPOE even when it was an easy throw; this is one observed outcome, not a skill estimate. Selected-throw details and hover show expected completion alongside the residual.

metricDefinitions.label: Lag contribution availability
metricDefinitions.definition: The top-bar LC is the original whole-season shownSpaceThrowers.lagContribution and stays fixed across distance/huck selections. It is explicitly labeled Whole season. The live database contains player-game and season aggregates but no per-throw lag column in prod.throws. A candidate reconstruction summing next raw aEC over 67,168 uniquely verified possession links matched only 2,961 of 5,383 official nonempty player-game LC totals and was rejected. No filtered LC is displayed, and per-throw lagContribution is null with an unavailable explanation. The exact source per-throw attribution rule or an authoritative per-throw export is required to supply it.

metricDefinitions.label: Filtered completion %
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed matching throws divided by all matching attempts, including drops as incomplete. Zero attempts means unavailable, not zero percent. Alex Atkins: 49/58 for 40+ yards; 45/53 for hucks. Jacques Nissen: 16/22 for 40+ yards; 15/20 for hucks. Descriptive rates, not adjusted for throw difficulty.

metricDefinitions.label: Share of all throws
metricDefinitions.definition: Matching attempts divided by all non-stall attempts by that player in the same snapshot, including playoffs. The denominators are 551 for Alex Atkins and 446 for Jacques Nissen. Missing-coordinate throws stay in the denominator and are disclosed; they cannot be assigned to a distance band or identified as hucks.

metricDefinitions.label: Throw field
metricDefinitions.definition: Both fields use the same 53.3 by 120 yard coordinate scale and attack toward increasing Y, shown to the right (source positive X points down). End zones are Y=0–20 and 100–120. A dot marks the throwing location and an arrow points to the recorded target. Complete throws are solid teal; incomplete throws and drops are dashed orange. Connectors are straight endpoint vectors, not tracked flight paths, running routes or receiver locations before the pass. Hover or the named highlight action can emphasize a single throw without changing the counts or plotted population.

metricDefinitions.label: Season completion %
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed non-stall passes / all non-stall attempts in the 2026 event export, including playoffs and drops. Drops are incomplete; zero attempts means unavailable. This retains the original explorer completion calculation (for Alex Atkins, 534 / 551 = 96.9% to one decimal). It is not the differently adjusted completion_percentage field in the Shown Space leaderboard. This season rate never changes when changing distance bands or the huck filter.

metricDefinitions.label: Simple throwing view
metricDefinitions.definition: All 2026 recorded non-stall passes by the selected thrower, including playoffs, drops and incomplete throws. No arbitrary sample-size minimum. Completion = completed / attempted throws, with drops incomplete. Zero attempts means unavailable, not zero percent.

metricDefinitions.label: Throw length
metricDefinitions.definition: Straight-line endpoint distance sqrt((rx-tx)^2+(ry-ty)^2). Display groups: 0 ≤ distance <10, 10 ≤ distance <20, 20 ≤ distance <40, and distance ≥40 yards. These are explicit display ranges, not learned player types. A 40+ yard throw is not necessarily a huck.

metricDefinitions.label: Throw direction
metricDefinitions.definition: Use the supplied throwAngle, normalized modulo 360, in twelve lower-inclusive 30-degree bins from prod.get_player_throw_directions. 0° is forward, 90° points toward decreasing source X (drawn to the left), 180° backward, 270° right. Draw each slice over its true angular range, centered at the midpoint. This new display uses the source bins with a field-oriented orientation, not the mirrored appearance of the old Shown Space reproduction. Zero-distance passes have no spatial direction and are excluded from the directional chart. Missing angles remain unavailable.

metricDefinitions.label: aEC for selected throws
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum the existing reviewed throwAec for exactly the displayed non-stall passes. It uses the supplied aec with drops credited zero to the thrower, following the source convention. Season aEC above additionally includes stalls. Never compute or imply a filtered LC from these records.

methods.code: src/content/dashboard/connections-model.js: buildConnections filters reviewed events by selected player, pass outcome and huck geometry after team/phase/line filtering; it groups incoming and outgoing passes separately by partner, retaining all remaining partners in Other players. selectedConnectionEvents resolves selected diagram endpoints to original event IDs. No pass sequence is inferred.

src/content/dashboard/radial-model.js: buildRadials applies selected player, outcome and huck filters to the page-scoped events, excludes missing throwAngle, normalizes modulo 360 and counts each role in twelve lower-inclusive 30-degree buckets. radialRecords resolves selected role/bucket to original source events. Grouping is from data/database-metadata/2026-10-12/get_player_throw_directions.sql; comparison fixture is alex-atkins-2026-radial.json. Radials.jsx reproduces the inspected reference orientation and radial-length scaling, with an optional shared percentage scale.

src/content/dashboard/deep-thrower-model.js: precedingPasses verifies unique consecutive passes within the filtered game/team/quarter/point/possession; buildDeepThrower computes completed-catch locations, matched prior-catch locations, and huck release-zone attempts, completions and Wilson intervals. deepThrowerComparison computes each player and release zone under the same huck and denominator rules; rankDeepThrowers applies total, zone and completion eligibility and orders the selected location. priorPassDirection and buildHuckSetups group all located next throws by incoming disc direction, separating huck choice from completion. selectHucks resolves spatial or setup selections to original hucks; sequenceSource includes their verified original preceding passes once. No archetype clusters or causal effects are fitted.

caveats: Exploratory historical test; these seasons were examined in prior work.
Profile cohort requires 100 throws and 100 completed catches, 6 games per role, one team per season.
A forced partition is not evidence of discrete archetypes. The Gaussian reference is an explicit assumption.
Completion comparisons adjust coarse geometry, not wind, marking, routes or receiver ability.
Geometry uses recorded endpoints retrospectively; it is not a forecast available before the throw.

Intervals are conditional on fitted models; repeated opponents and profile uncertainty remain.
This is the October 12 export, not a live database refresh.
Missing regular-season coverage includes one Pittsburgh game; sample floors exclude low-involvement roles.
Selected-player comparisons use 2026 observed profiles. The weighting scale comes from 227 eligible 2025 players.

metricDefinitions.label: Style distance
metricDefinitions.definition: Square root of the sum of weight × ((player trait − candidate trait) / 2025 standard deviation)². Four groups each receive 25% weight: passing choices, throwing locations, catching locations and disc involvement. Lower means more similar; zero means identical measured traits. No performance, team, name or absolute volume is a matching feature.

metricDefinitions.label: Huck
metricDefinitions.definition: Forward gain ReceiverY − ThrowerY > 30 yards AND Euclidean flight distance > 40 yards. Boundaries are strict. Offense always attacks toward Y=120.

metricDefinitions.label: Profile traits
metricDefinitions.definition: Short throws travel ≤10 yd. Forward throws gain more yards than absolute lateral displacement; backward throws lose more than absolute lateral displacement. Near-sideline means |X|≥15 yd. Catch traits use completed catches. Involvement is throws/(throws+completed catches), not on-field possession share.

metricDefinitions.label: Completion versus geometry expectation
metricDefinitions.definition: 2026 actual completion minus expected completion from a penalized additive logistic model trained on 2021–2025 named, located, non-stall regular throws. Inputs: distance and forward-gain bands, throwing-Y band, near-sideline and end-zone target. Shown in percentage points. 95% intervals resample each player’s whole games 2,000 times, conditional on the fitted model; they do not establish intrinsic skill.

metricDefinitions.label: Archetype pilot
metricDefinitions.definition: K-means with 20 starts; K=2–6; every group ≥max(12, 5% of profiles). Choose smallest K within .02 of best silhouette. Compare 100 correlated Gaussian references; refit 60 whole-team bootstraps. Screening gates: reference tail<.05, median refit ARI≥.8, later half-season ARI≥.6. Gates are pilot choices, not universal standards. Neither year passes all three.

metricDefinitions.label: Performance repeatability
metricDefinitions.definition: Compare next-year Brier error for geometry + prior-year team offsets + prior-year player offsets against geometry + team alone. Offsets use ridge precision 5. Only players with 100 prior-year throws are evaluated. Positive relative improvement is better. 95% intervals resample games 5,000 times; neither year excludes zero. Player-bootstrap sensitivity is retained in the research result.

metricDefinitions.label: sourceCpoe
metricDefinitions.definition: (Completed passes + recorded drops) / all non-stall passes minus mean available cp, matching cached player-game aggregate convention. Drops receive thrower success credit. Expected completion excludes missing cp; matchedCpoe retains a sensitivity using only scored passes in both terms. The stored per-pass cpoe field equals 1 on drops and is not averaged.

metricDefinitions.label: completionRate
metricDefinitions.definition: Actual completions / all non-stall passes, including drops as incompletions.

metricDefinitions.label: huck
metricDefinitions.definition: Forward gain >30 yards AND Euclidean flight >40 yards, strictly.

metricDefinitions.label: directions
metricDefinitions.definition: Forward: gain > abs(lateral displacement). Backward: -gain > abs(lateral displacement). Lateral: remainder. Exact 45-degree boundaries are lateral. Disc direction does not identify a cutting route or forehand/backhand.

metricDefinitions.label: hockeyAssists
metricDefinitions.definition: Completed immediately preceding pass before a source goal (event type 19), verified unique consecutive possession_throw, same game/team/quarter/point/possession, receiver=next thrower, increasing unique global_event_seq.

metricDefinitions.label: throwerAec
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum supplied aec including stalls, with drops credited zero to thrower; source model, no division by attempts.

metricDefinitions.label: percentile
metricDefinitions.definition: Midrank among eligible throwers, descriptive style position, not quality.

metricDefinitions.label: Passing choices and distances
metricDefinitions.definition: Short passes have flight ≤10 yards. Forward gain is ReceiverY − ThrowerY; flight is Euclidean endpoint distance. All passing shares and means exclude stalls but retain incomplete passes. Non-huck mean gain excludes only passes meeting both strict huck thresholds.

metricDefinitions.label: Throwing locations
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean ThrowerY, from 0 at the back of the own end zone toward 120 at the back of the attacking end zone. Near-sideline share uses |ThrowerX| ≥15 yards.

metricDefinitions.label: League comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: Median of each metric across all 249 qualifying 2026 throwers, each weighted equally. The baseline does not change with team, search, sorting or selected player.

metricDefinitions.label: Observed profile descriptions
metricDefinitions.definition: Choose the two strongest absolute departures from the 50th style percentile among short-pass share, lateral share, mean forward gain, average throwing Y and near-sideline share. State actual values against the fixed league median. These are overlapping measured tendencies, not learned archetype assignments; outcomes are not inputs.

metricDefinitions.label: advance
metricDefinitions.definition: Gain > abs(lateral displacement): forward-directed passes within 45 degrees of straight ahead. Gain = ReceiverY − ThrowerY; attack is toward Y=120.

metricDefinitions.label: redistribute
metricDefinitions.definition: All remaining physical passes: lateral or backward. Exact 45-degree boundaries are lateral. This is a directional proxy; it does not prove tactical intent or measure off-disc organization.

metricDefinitions.label: score
metricDefinitions.definition: Recorded target Y ≥100, including the goal line, regardless of completion. Includes hucks and short end-zone passes; may overlap either direction group. Assists are counted separately from source event type 19 plus complete=true. No attempt is classified by its outcome.

metricDefinitions.label: share
metricDefinitions.definition: Role attempts / all non-stall passes by the player. Advancement + redistribution =100%; scoring overlaps them and is not added.

metricDefinitions.label: completion
metricDefinitions.definition: Actual completed passes / role attempts. Recorded drops remain incomplete.

metricDefinitions.label: cpoe
metricDefinitions.definition: 100 × ((completions + recorded drops)/attempts − mean supplied cp on available scored role passes). Drops receive thrower credit, matching the existing source-aggregate convention. Expected completion excludes missing cp. This is a retrospective supplied-model comparison, not intrinsic player skill.

metricDefinitions.label: intervals
metricDefinitions.definition: Pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 within-player whole-game bootstrap replicates, keeping zero-role games. Display only with ≥20 role attempts and ≥6 games containing the role. Conditional on the supplied cp model; not simultaneous best-player tests.

metricDefinitions.label: totals
metricDefinitions.definition: Role thrower aEC sums supplied throwAec for these physical passes, drops credited zero. Stalls do not have a pass direction and are excluded here. No aEC/attempt metric is used. Completed gain sums only completed pass Y changes; resets can have negative gain.

metricDefinitions.label: repeatability
metricDefinitions.definition: Per-player chronological first half of observed games versus remaining games. Shares use players with ≥50 total passes in each half; completion/CPOE additionally require ≥20 role attempts in each half. Spearman rank correlation measures same-season association, not future-season prediction. Team context and supplied-model fitting are not controlled.

metricDefinitions.label: baseline
metricDefinitions.definition: Pooled pass-weighted outcomes from the fixed cohort of 249 qualifying throwers. Quartiles describe equally weighted player shares. Neither baseline changes with team, search, or sample controls.

caveats: October 12, 2026 export, regular season and all lines. Pittsburgh at Chicago on July 18 has no exported throws.
Advancement and redistribution are complementary directional categories; their frequency correlations are mechanically identical. They are not two independent discoveries.
Scoring-target completions on the goal line can be recorded as non-goals. Display actual source assists separately; do not equate target completions with goals.
Shares reflect opportunities and team roles. Low involvement, multiple-team seasons and fewer than six observed games are outside the fixed cohort.
No force direction, receiver routes, defensive positioning, wind, possession scoring probability or replacement effects are inferred.
Player rankings and intervals are exploratory and descriptive. No natural clusters or fixed archetype labels are fitted in this study.
Role CPOE uses supplied probabilities without an independent calibration check. Whole-game intervals cannot remove unmeasured context or model error.
Minimum-attempt and team/search controls filter the displayed players. The pooled league benchmark remains the fixed qualifying cohort.
42 completed goal-line targets in the cohort are not recorded as goals; actual source assists stay separate.
